description: Piggy (rebranded Leat) is a loyalty platform. This plugin manages contacts and their credit, prepaid and tier state, records direct points and reward redemptions with their reversals, issues and redeems vouchers and giftcards, reads promotions, loyalty programs and business profiles, and manages webhook subscriptions with signature-verified deliveries.
